## Hypothesis

The strategy combines a 75% profit target, 35% stop loss, 12-minute time stop, OTM-2 strikes, 60% chandelier profit-lock arm, and a volume ratio threshold of 1.2 to capture intraday mean-reversion moves in SPY 0DTE puts. The edge exists due to short-term momentum exhaustion after sharp moves, allowing premium decay to be harvested with defined risk.

## Mechanism

Enter on the first 5m bar where volume exceeds 1.2x the 20-bar average VWAP, with the EMA ribbon bearish (for puts) and price below the VWAP. Exit at 75% premium gain, 35% premium loss, or 12 minutes whichever comes first. Chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% gain and trails 15% off the high-water mark.
